summary.headline: ABREL 1HFY27 collections rose 39% YoY to INR1,465 crores, while Q2 presales were a flat INR298 crores after Niyaara Tower C was deferred to FY28.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 showed strong collections (INR752 crores, up 47% YoY) and revenue recognition (Q2 total income INR268 crores, up 755% YoY), but net presales of INR298 crores were soft. Management redesigned Niyaara Tower C, adding about INR3,000 crores to Tower C GDV (net Worli GDV addition about INR1,900 crores), and deferred its launch to Q2 FY28. New business development (BD) added about INR6,200 crores of GDV in FY27 so far, and management reiterated the INR10,000 crores BD guidance and INR15,000 crores presales target by FY29. Management declined to give a FY27 presales number and said the company is net debt zero.

segments.name: Birla Tisya (Thane/Pune residential, revenue recognised)
segments.commentary: Recognised EBITDA of INR181 crores at 28% margin; most of the project's revenue is already recognised, and handover was about 4-5 months ahead of RERA timeline with NPS of 95%.

segments.name: Birla Navya (NCR)
segments.commentary: Recognised EBITDA of INR39 crores at 35% margin in the quarter.

segments.name: Birla Niyaara (Worli, MMR)
segments.commentary: Tower A (401 of 413 units sold) and Tower B (119 of 148 sold) are nearly sold out; Tower C redesign adds about INR3,000 crores GDV, with launch now guided for Q2 FY28. Tower A RERA date is March 2028; management said Niyaara margins are 40% and above.

segments.name: Birla Arika and Birla Pravaah (NCR)
segments.commentary: Arika has about 475 apartments sold across two phases (about INR4,700 crores), with 11 cancellations (about INR114 crores in Q2 per analyst). Pravaah fully sold at about INR1,850 crores, with 3 cancellations rebooked at higher prices.

segments.name: Birla Mrida (plotted, Bengaluru/MMR)
segments.commentary: Launched March 2026, about 160 plots sold; management described sales as slowing and investor-driven, with revenue recognition expected next year.

segments.name: Commercial / annuity
segments.commentary: Annual rental income of about INR150 crores targeted to rise to INR1,500 crores; first step is 1.3 million sq ft commercial building in Worli, with about 9-10 months for approvals and about 4 years construction. Estimated capex about INR1,400-1,500 crores over 4 years; FY27 construction spend about INR1,300 crores.

guidance_outlook: Presales target of INR15,000 crores by FY29 reaffirmed; management declined to give FY27 presales guidance and said INR8,000 crores for FY27 is 'not' achievable.

BD target of INR10,000-15,000 crores GDV; about INR6,200 crores added in FY27 so far (including Niyaara Tower C), with another INR3,000-5,000 crores expected; management expects to cross INR10,000 crores.
Acquisition cost guided at about 15-17% of GDV added.
Niyaara Tower C launch deferred to Q2 FY28; Khar expected Jan-Feb 2027; Vashi, new Taranya and Punya phases and Hinjewadi project targeted for Q4 FY28 (Vashi next year).
Revenue recognition for FY27 is largely complete; Niyaara Tower A handovers to fall partly in March 2028 and partly March 2029.
Commercial annual income target of INR1,500 crores (from INR150 crores); Century Bhavan redevelopment expected to add INR400-450 crores of rent.
Company is net debt zero; open to gearing up depending on acquisitions.
capex_capacity: Worli 1.3 million sq ft commercial building planned as part of Niyaara; design being finalised, construction to start after approvals (about 9-10 months).
Commercial capex of about INR1,400-1,500 crores (debt plus equity) over about 4 years; FY27 construction spend about INR1,300 crores.
Niyaara Tower C redesigned with additional FSI; higher floors to have larger apartments and lower floors smaller units; configuration still being finalised.
Hinjewadi Phase 1 (Pune) JDA for 5.6 acres, GDV about INR1,650 crores; 75:25 revenue share, upfront about INR50 crores, expected margin about 30%.
Company estimates remaining cost of launched projects at about INR12,963 crores (per slide 27), covering construction, approvals and unsold inventory.
demand_pricing: Q2 FY27 net presales INR298 crores, driven by Birla Taranya and Birla Niyaara in MMR; Taranya sold about INR250 crores across the two quarters.
Management said net sales (not gross) are the reported metric; cancellations were not disclosed in aggregate.
Project EBITDA margins range 25-30% (per CFO); Niyaara margins 40% and above.
MMR sales about INR59,500 crores in 2QFY27 (up 11% YoY); commercial leasing 21 million sq ft in Q2 (up 6% YoY), GCCs about 41% of leasing.
Management said luxury and above INR1 crore segments remain resilient while sub-INR1 crore segment is contracting.
Sustenance sales (around INR3 billion per quarter per analyst) below expectation; management said 78% of inventory sold, with some projects (Birla Mrida) lagging.

qa_highlights.question: What were gross presales and cancellations in Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reported only net sales of INR298 crores and did not give gross or cancellation figures.

qa_highlights.question: Why was Niyaara Tower C GDV raised by about INR2,000-3,000 crores, and what does it mean for launch timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Amalgamating the original Niyaara plot with the Wadia plot allowed FSI to be loaded onto Tower C, raising its GDV by INR3,000 crores; net Worli GDV rises INR1,900 crores after deferring other value. Launch now targeted Q2 FY28, with no consideration paid for the FSI reconfiguration.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 presales falling short, and why not prepone launches such as Arika phase 2 or Vashi?
qa_highlights.answer: Management refused to guide FY27 presales (said INR8,000 crores is not achievable) and kept Arika phase 2 for later to extract more value and allow construction progress; Vashi launch next year.

qa_highlights.question: How is BD progressing against the INR10,000-15,000 crores guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR6,200 crores of new GDV added in FY27 including Niyaara Tower C; management expects to cross INR10,000 crores within the year, with acquisition cost about 15-17% of GDV.

qa_highlights.question: Why are NCR cancellations rising at Arika and Pravaah?
qa_highlights.answer: Arika had about 11 cancellations on about 475 apartments (about INR4,700 crores sold), mostly non-payment terminations; 6 units resold about INR2,000 per sq ft higher. Pravaah had 3 cancellations, all rebooked at higher prices.

qa_highlights.question: How much EBITDA and revenue will Niyaara Tower A recognise in FY28 and FY29?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue is recognised on possession; no EBITDA recognised yet on Tower A. Handovers partly in March 2028 and partly March 2029, with Niyaara margins 40%+; management declined to estimate net profit.

qa_highlights.question: What is the commercial rental and capex plan?
qa_highlights.answer: Annual rental income target raised from INR150 crores to above INR1,500 crores over time, including Century Bhavan redevelopment (INR400-450 crores) and the 1.3 million sq ft Worli commercial building; the 2.3 million sq ft Wadia plot is excluded from this target.

risks_watch: Presales lumpiness: Niyaara Tower C deferral to FY28 and limited Niyaara inventory mean FY27 presales likely well below FY26 levels.
Sustenance sales weakness at Birla Mrida (plotted, investor-driven) and some other projects; negative sales from reversals at Niyaara and others.
NCR cancellations (Arika about 11 units, Pravaah 3 units) and whether resale pricing holds.
Revenue and EBITDA recognition timing for Niyaara Tower A depends on customer possession and payment.
Execution of BD target of INR10,000 crores+ and funding; company moving from net debt zero, open to gearing up.
Transparency: management declined to give short-term guidance and gross presales/cancellation figures; CFO deferred project-margin reconciliation to offline discussion.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term value, collections and execution, but cautious and evasive on near-term presales, refusing to quantify FY27 sales or give cancellation data. Analysts pressed on the mismatch between presales trajectory and the share price; management responded that presales is only one metric.
key_quotes: I think the investors should very clearly see this as a long-term investment, not a short-term linear sort of a sale company.
We stand firm to our commitment of reaching presales of INR15,000 crores by FY '29.
So, it's not just presales, presales is only one part of it.
We are cash positive. Construction is going well. We're well capitalized.

adds.what: 1.3 million sq ft commercial building in Worli (Niyaara) to add annual rental income; target INR1,500 crores from INR150 crores
Niyaara Tower C redesign adding about INR3,000 crores GDV; launch deferred to Q2 FY28
Hinjewadi Phase 1 (Pune) JDA 5.6 acres, GDV about INR1,650 crores, targeted Q4 FY28

growth.why: Management reaffirmed INR15,000 crore presales by FY29 and BD of INR10,000 crore+ for FY27 (INR6,200 crore added so far), but declined to guide FY27 presales and said INR8,000 crore is not achievable; Q2 net presales were flat at INR298 crore with Niyaara Tower C deferred to Q2 FY28, so backing is partial with specific projects but no firm FY27 revenue number.
